Closed vocabulary: long LLM prompts and messages will have unread sentences, which are listed.
Play strength against Haiku or Sol is not measured; no live provider call was made.
No hashing in Heel Turn or its tests: equality is checked by bytes. Where a digest is ever needed it goes through crypto's Foreign Runtime provider, never the pure-ooRexx path.
Designer prompts are sealed until unsealed by the competition: they are never test fixtures. tests/fixtures/constructs.txt holds constructions written for the tests.
